name: Kashima Yuuzou
source:
"Also referred to as the Demon Coach due to his harsh, Spartan methods. He is an OB of MANKAI Company, previously belonging to the original Spring Troupe. On several occasions, he is brought in to advise and coach the company members. He currently works as an actor and director at a different company, and also lectures at a theatre school."
